_about: Cat animation asset library for mendoza-ph.com. NOT used by the landing page yet. Add one entry per new clip. Times are in seconds.
format: MP4 (H.264 video + audio track), 1280x720, 24 fps, 10.0 s, 240 frames

animations.name: Cat_Walking
animations.behaviour: Adult long-haired grey cat walking naturally on four legs, slowly, across a wooden floor.

segments.action: turns toward the camera and stops, standing

animations.intended_use: Moving the cat from one spot in the room to another (wandering, crossing the foreground, walking to a toy, bowl, bed or photo).
animations.integration_notes: The camera follows the cat, and the clip is filmed in a different room (grey sofa, wooden floor). The cat has to be cut out (transparent video or image sequence) before it can walk inside our room.

animations.name: Cat_Sitting
animations.behaviour: Adult cat walking, stopping and sitting down naturally, ending seated and facing the viewer.

segments.action: walking (almost identical to the start of Cat_Walking)
stops and lowers into a sit

animations.intended_use: Transition from walking to sitting, and the seated idle pose, including 'staring at the viewer' at the end.
animations.integration_notes: Same room and moving camera as Cat_Walking. Useful segment for the sit is about 5.5 to 10 s.

animations.name: Cat_Scratching
animations.behaviour: Adult cat walking to a sisal scratching post, standing up on its back legs and scratching it, then sitting down beside it.

segments.action: sits at the base of the post
stretches up and scratches the post with the front paws
drops back down and sits beside the post

animations.intended_use: Scratching the cat tower or scratching post in the room.
animations.integration_notes: The clip includes its own scratching post, which would need to line up with a post in our room or be kept in the cut-out. The camera moves.

animations.name: Cat_Playing
animations.behaviour: Adult cat playing with a small yellow ball: pawing it, following it, crouching, rolling onto its side to bat it, then sitting up.

segments.action: lies on its side batting the ball

animations.integration_notes: The toy is a yellow ball, which isn't one of the toys in our room. It would need to stay in the cut-out, or our toy would need to follow its path. The camera moves.
